name: google-plan
summary: Your Google AI plan does the work through agy: Gemini 3.8 Flash builds, Gemini 3.1 Pro takes the hard tickets, GPT-OSS (another vendor, same plan) reviews.
optional: claude: risky work and a backup reviewer
gemini-key: the same Gemini models when agy's quota runs out
capacity: agy's individual quota; when it runs out (it resets in hours or days) the same Gemini models answer through a free key
caveats: agy's quota is per account and resets on its own schedule; sysop rests agy until then and says when.
agy cannot run the runtime verifier, so verify stays on Claude or pi.
